key_insight: The classical communication cost of simulating quantum state transmission equals that of simulating prepare-and-broadcast quantum correlations, growing exponentially with quantum dimension and as a power law in inverse noise.
engineering_relevance: Classical complexity provides a resource benchmark for quantum communication advantage and tools to certify that advantage in quantum preparation devices.
method: Define minimum-cost classical communication models for quantum preparations.
Prove resource equivalence with simulations of prepare-and-broadcast correlations.
Develop exact semidefinite-programming characterisations, analytical witnesses and scalable convex optimisation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical scaling results and convex-programming methods scalable to hundreds, and sometimes thousands, of qubit states, rather than hardware measurements.
watch_item: Practical certification depends on computational tractability; the reported optimisation scale is not a guarantee for arbitrary preparation sets.
paper_title: The classical complexity of quantum state transmission
